name: tmc-autotune
title: TMC Auto-Tuned
author: bespoked
description: Applies optimized TMC2240 driver settings (StealthChop tuning, CoolStep, hysteresis) to the X and Y steppers, from Argolein's SnapmakerU1 custom config. These modify low-level driver registers, so monitor motor temperatures on first use. Works only on the Snapmaker U1.
tagline: Argolein's optimized TMC2240 driver parameters for X/Y.
